data.body: Operator-authorized default 2026-09-07: choose the narrow checker extension, not a broad audit ticket. Rationale: the ticket describes a specific gate blind spot and the documented-best-practice default is to implement the smallest diagnosable behavior that prevents recurrence; any broader audit can be discovered separately if implementation reveals additional latent flakes. Acceptance target: check_wall_clock_asserts should flag equality/inequality assertions comparing read_bytes()/read_text() output from separate artifact paths when the test lacks a frozen clock, while avoiding existing frozen-clock/irrelevant comparisons.
